data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that animates text by revealing it letter by letter with a random character effect.
data.what_it_does: Provides a RandomTextReveal widget that generates random characters and slowly reveals the target text. Allows customization via parameters like duration, style, curve, initial text, and random string sources.
use_when: You want a movie-style hacker or password-cracking text reveal effect
You need to animate text appearance using random characters
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based or vector motion animations
You require standard layout-only text animations like fading or sliding
strengths: Supports custom character sets and animation curves
Includes autoplay configuration and completion callbacks
weaknesses: Limited to random text reveal animations only
No documentation found on advanced timeline control beyond basic methods
